Proposed amendment: use eligible-source fractions 0/10/30/50%, publish actual global corruption, and require a development attack-viability margin.

Hulk is unseen. Mislabeled source rows can have low benign loss, defeating selection, while legitimate Hulk is fully protected. Clarification: state conditional rejection and possible poison preservation; treat null or adverse security effects as valid outcomes.

The local MachineLearningCSV headers lack the identifiers needed to reconstruct sessions. Dataset defects confound artificial corruption. Proposed amendment: require an audited metadata sidecar, a bidirectional endpoint key and proposed 120-second gap; cite verified Engelen–Rimmer–Joosen evidence and quarantine disputed joins/labels.

No threshold determines which classwise scores are credible. Current Heartbleed/SQL-injection/Infiltration train/test counts are 8/3, 15/6 and 25/11. Proposed amendment: require 50/50/50 rows after grouping for confirmatory scoring, exclude inadequate families without semantic pooling, and block lock if the source or anchors fail.

The estimands lack formal definitions. Changing source endpoints also changes multiplicity. Proposed amendment: define symmetric paired-location nulls and alternatives, eighteen C1 contrasts and eleven C2 contrasts; mark all other analyses exploratory. Two families protect separate questions, without claiming experiment-wide error control.

Seed resolution is unstated. Fix: report minimum exact two-sided p-values and Holm thresholds. Nine nonzero pairs can permit rejection in the eleven-test family; the amended eighteen-test family needs at least ten. These bounds are not power estimates.

The verified Guo manuscript places 83.4/82.1% in Table 6; Table 5 describes applicability. Fix: correct both prose and comparison cells, retaining Table 12's verified 76.4% ablation. This is a factual error.

Global time cuts can leave late-occurring families without usable training/development support. Proposed amendment: group sessions within majority-label strata and allocate chronologically inside strata. Explicitly characterize the resulting ordered-family benchmark and its tradeoff with global chronology; qualify temporal claims.

The design has hundreds of runs but no executable resource estimate. Proposed amendment: enumerate 81 development, 288 main, 72 external and 192 optional full runs, plus 24 continuations. Leave tier time unmeasured. Reduce scope to 321 planned runs if necessary, retaining twelve seeds and disclosing incomplete external coverage.

Stage indexing is missing, and acquisition uses learner-announced classes despite label corruption. Proposed amendment: score fixed evaluator-scheduled new families within stage-specific supported banks; absent learner outputs score zero and empty new-family banks block protocol lock.

Inspection shows the federation loop replaces EWC anchors between rounds; violating the experience-level penalty. Fix/proposed amendment: mark implementation partial, freeze each stored anchor throughout the experience, then update admitted-data importance/anchor after final shared broadcast.

The keep-fraction sensitivity requires changing both DC and matched DM, so 144 optional runs undercounts the design. Fix: budget eight changed arm settings, producing 192 full runs; distinguish 633 enumerated full runs from 24 diagnostic continuations and unbudgeted calibration/reruns.

Source inspection shows benign subsampling occurs before train/test splitting, changing evaluation priors. Proposed amendment: preserve natural development/test counts; sample only whole benign training sessions toward a disclosed 3,500-row target. Show legacy benign counts and prohibit claims that they represent natural test prevalence.

Position the study as a controlled security–adaptation protocol plus a heuristic, preserving the existing DER++ repairs as reused mechanics.

Equations overload gradients, counters, moments, capacities and losses. Fix: use metadata sigma/tau, gradient xi, Adam moments mu/nu and decays gamma, capacity m and memory script-B, poison count Q, selector S and teacher width omega; enumerate domains and shapes in a notation table.

The invariant's conditioning and time horizon are unspecified. Clarification: after V unique admitted encounters, every encountered ID is resident with probability min(1,m/V). State the initial-pass insertion gate and connect expected rare-family underrepresentation to balanced eviction.

The draft already disclaims exact Fisher estimation, so that lead is partly satisfied. Remaining defect: uncalibrated penalty scale. assessment_and_action: Accuracy and inclusive forgetting are already identified in the draft. Ties and the total quota already exist, so the lead is partly satisfied. Clarification: make zero-count classes explicit and add illustrative 100/10/40 arithmetic giving 125 admissions. Show that label corruption can alter quota categories even with matched volumes.

This has sound intent but no canonical serialization or executable disjointness condition. Proposed amendment: define little-endian float32/SHA-256 canonicalization, signed-zero normalization, train/development/test feature and session disjointness, and a frozen T0-only scaler.

Twelve observations make percentile coverage unstable; more resamples do not create information. Proposed amendment: retain vector bootstrap summaries and add enumerated sign-flip mean-effect interval inversion, conditional on independent symmetric effects. Distinguish ordinary intervals from simultaneous family intervals.

This limitation is already present. Clarification: list randomized ownership, attacked client/IDs, order, initialization, replay and dropout, and fixed files, sessions and banks. Pairing reduces conditional algorithmic variability; it supplies no independent organizational sample.

That statement never maps the three sources and remaining gaps. Fix: re-engage Ge/Wu/Luo, retain client poisoning, narrow arbitrary updates to data corruption, defer discovery evasion/RF spoofing, and partially address deployment cost through host/byte measurements.

Fix: include verified participation/dataset dependence from Section 5.4/Figure 10, including weak one-attacker effects; retain clean scores only as background. Use author-year labels; move folder identifiers to Appendix A.

The introduction exposes source paths before motivating a research question. Fix: write a compact problem/RQ/contribution/scope introduction and move component/file/status/protocol-role evidence into Appendix B. Preserve the four Phase 1 quotations verbatim.

Prose names many factors without comparable levels or controls. Fix: add factor/levels/held-fixed/endpoint rows and a failure taxonomy. Keep admission composition distinct from eviction and logit/label losses; reserve additional budgets for protection-boundary or richer-validation extensions.
The equation still leaves an all-empty synchronization round undefined. Fix: omit empty contributors and retain the server model when there are none. This prevents undefined aggregation.

Its implementation rounds the retained count; the proposed class quotas use ceilings. Clarification: label DG's implemented rounding and DM/DC's proposed ceiling policy in Appendix B. Only DM/DC share quota counts, so DG cannot serve as the matched-volume causal control.

In multiclass prediction, other-family errors mean ASR is not one minus source recall. Fix: define both independently, show source acquisition damage and benign-target persistence, and prevent metrics/reporting code from treating them as complementary quantities.

A single FIN closes one TCP direction, making the proposed session boundary premature. Fix: require both-direction FINs or RST, preserve retransmissions and use upstream capture checksums; quarantine/re-extract crossing flows and verify packet-level metadata before grouping.

Weight bytes or uplink payload alone cannot identify federation communication cost. Fix: measure uplink, downlink and control traffic separately from numeric parameter bytes; distinguish real serialization overhead from the float32 model-size formula.
